name: adhikar-workspace
description: ADHIKAR — AI-Powered Citizen Grievance + RTI Assistant (SIH Workspace)

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix adhikar-backend && npm install --prefix adhikar-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm start --prefix adhikar-backend" "npm run dev --prefix adhikar-frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix adhikar-backend" "npm run dev --prefix adhikar-frontend"
